title: Create, Update, Delete aur Mass Assignment
objectives: Naya record banane ke tareeke (`save`, `create`) jaanna

sections.heading: Create
sections.body: Do tareeke: object banake `save()`, ya `create()` jo ek line mein banata aur save karta hai.
explain: `save()` insert ya update dono karta hai, model ki state ke hisaab se.

sections.heading: Update aur delete
sections.body: Model utha ke badlo ya seedha update/delete karo:

callout.text: `Product::where('is_active', false)->delete()` jaise mass update/delete Eloquent model events nahi chalate. Events chahiye to models load karke ek-ek delete karo.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Mass assignment aur $fillable
sections.body: `Product::create($request->all())` likhna khatarnak hai. Agar user form mein chhupa `is_admin=1` ya `price=0` bhej de to? **Mass assignment vulnerability**. Isliye model mein batao ki kaunse columns bharna allowed hain:
explain: `$fillable` allow-list hai: sirf yahi columns mass assign hote hain.
`$request->validate()` sirf validated keys return karta hai, isliye `create($data)` safe hai (validation Module 10 mein).
`$guarded = []` mat use karo, woh sab kuch allow kar deta hai.

callout.text: Kabhi `Product::create($request->all())` mat likho. Hamesha validated data (`validate()`/`validated()`) ya `$request->only([...])` use karo.

versionDiff.heading: Mass assignment: Laravel 11, 12 aur 13
versionDiff.intro: `create`, `update`, `delete` aur mass assignment ke rules teeno versions mein same hain.

items.13: `$fillable` abhi bhi chalta hai. Optional `#[Fillable([...])]` attribute bhi hai (13 docs ke hisaab se).

errors.error: Add [name] to fillable property to allow mass assignment on [App\Models\Product]
errors.cause: `create()`/`fill()` mein ek aisi key hai jo `$fillable` mein nahi.
errors.fix: Model ke `$fillable` mein column jodo (sirf safe columns).

errors.error: SQLSTATE[23000]: NOT NULL constraint failed: products.price (ya Field 'price' doesn't have a default value)
errors.cause: Required column ki value nahi di.
errors.fix: Value do, ya migration mein `default()`/`nullable()` lagao.
Models ko load karke instance par `update()`/`delete()` karo.

debug.body: Save hua ya nahi, aur kya badla, Tinker mein dekho.

tasks: `$fillable` hata ke `create()` chalao aur error padho, phir wapas lagao
`firstOrCreate` do baar chalao aur dekho duplicate nahi bana
`store` method likho jo `validate()` ke baad `create()` kare

options: User kisi bhi column ko mass assign kar sakta hai
quiz.why: Mass assignment: user extra fields bhej kar unhe bhi set kar sakta hai.

options: Allow-list jo columns mass assign ho sakte hain
quiz.why: `$fillable` batata hai kaunse columns mass assign ho sakte hain.
Pehla array dhundta hai, mile to update, na mile to create.

interview.a: Jab `create()`/`fill()` mein user ka poora input jaata hai aur woh koi bhi column (jaise `is_admin`) set kar deta hai. `$fillable` allow-list se bachav.
`save()` ek model object ko save karta hai. `create()` array se model banata aur save karta hai (fillable chahiye).
Duplicate bachane ke liye: pehle dhundo, na mile to banao.
`isDirty()` save se pehle check karta hai, `wasChanged()` save ke baad.
